entities.summary: Hans Nathan Feibusch was a German painter and sculptor of Jewish heritage who lived and worked in Britain from 1933 until his death. He is best known for his murals, particularly in Anglican churches. In all he worked in thirty Anglican churches and produced what is probably the largest body of work in his particular métier by any artist in the history of the Church of England.
